payload.reason: The M2.2-IMPLEMENT-002 report provides sufficient evidence that the approved implementation scope is complete and ready for checkpoint verification. All six required modal workflows use the existing x-ui.modal component, the client-side workspace behavior and AJAX bindings are implemented against the M2.1 backend contract, and the show() request-negotiation correction restores the expected distinction between JSON clients and normal browser view rendering. The dedicated workspace feature test passes, the existing controller and model suites continue to pass, and the full application suite passes with 29 tests and 214 assertions and zero regressions. Every reported file remains within the 500-line Blade ceiling, no duplicate UI infrastructure or custom CSS was introduced, and User.php, database state, migrations, routes, and control-plane state remain untouched. The Slice 2 scope therefore satisfies the approved architectural, design-system, safety, and verification requirements. M2.2 is approved to proceed to formal checkpoint verification; no further implementation work is authorized before that checkpoint.
